widget.title: Agent reports per day, by optional tools called ('none' = only the 8 core tools)

text.content: The prompt lets the agent decide whether to call **find_replacements**, **search_news** and **search_news_archive**, so an all-'none' bar is often correct. To find reports where skipping one may have hurt, look at the Monday weekly review's *Maybe should have called* line: those are reports the judge scored 2 or under on the criterion the skipped tool answers. Before this chart (10/16-10/30): find_replacements 2/59, both searches 0/59.
